toefl:se:327.answer: I'm very sorry, but I won't be able to attend your birthday party because I have to travel out of town for a family event on the same day.

travel out of town
toefl:se:327.japanese: 本当に申し訳ないのですが、同じ日に家族の行事で遠方へ出張しなければならないため、あなたの誕生日パーティーに出席できません。
toefl:se:327.explanation: travel out of townで「遠方へ出かける、出張する」を表す。
toefl:se:327.relatedInfo: have to be away that day / need to leave town for a family matter

toefl:se:328.answer: I feel really disappointed to miss your celebration; I was looking forward to it and wish I could be there.
toefl:se:328.fullSentence: I feel really disappointed to miss your celebration; I was looking forward to it and wish I could be there.

wish i could be there

toefl:se:328.explanation: wish I could〜は仮定法で「〜できたらいいのに」という願望。
toefl:se:328.relatedInfo: really wish I could make it / would love to be there but can't

toefl:se:329.answer: I'd love to meet up with you another time to celebrate together.

toefl:se:329.relatedInfo: hope to celebrate together soon / would love to catch up another time

toefl:se:330.answer: Please let me know when you're free, and we can make some plans.

keyPhrases: let me know when you're free

toefl:se:330.relatedInfo: tell me your availability / let's figure out a plan

toefl:se:331.japanese: 近いうちにお会いできるのを楽しみにしています。

toefl:se:336.answer: I'm really disappointed about missing the chance to celebrate with you and the rest of our friends.

toefl:se:336.relatedInfo: sad to miss out on celebrating / hate missing the chance to be there

toefl:se:337.answer: I was looking forward to all the fun and laughter we always have at your parties, and I will definitely miss being a part of your special day.

toefl:se:337.explanation: be a part ofで「〜の一部になる」を表す。
toefl:se:337.relatedInfo: looking forward to the fun as always / will really miss celebrating with you

toefl:se:338.relatedInfo: to make up for it / to compensate for missing it

toefl:se:339.relatedInfo: whenever works for you / at a time that's convenient for you

toefl:se:340.answer: Please let me know what works best for you—I'd love to catch up and celebrate your birthday together soon.

toefl:se:340.japanese: 一番都合の良い方法を教えてください。近いうちにあなたの誕生日を一緒にお祝いできることを楽しみにしています。

toefl:se:340.relatedInfo: tell me your availability / excited to celebrate with you soon

toefl:se:341.answer: Take care, and I hope the party is a blast!
